study.question: On the under_normalized host with the conv_heavy seed and graft lifecycle v2, does a scheduled mid-training graft repair the deficit: does it beat no growth beyond delta, without static capacity from step zero beating it? Partial repair is named (partial_capture).
based_on: graft-capture-v1 (never run: its launch condition, positive-control-v1 control_passes, did not hold). This plan is v1 plus the deviations listed below.

lifecycle-v2-validation (PDR-0051, accepted) cell B: v2's graft diverged in 0/24 units here. Its descriptive late-CE contrasts were SEEN: graft - no growth -0.054, static - no growth -0.142, graft - static +0.0877 (capture about 0.382). This study is a confirmatory replication of that seen exploratory estimate on fresh seeds, not an independent discovery. Only the sd is borrowed for sizing.
study.sibling: graft-capture-v2-norm runs the same seeds on the other seed type. The two share one host trajectory per seed, so their results are correlated: each is read on its own and nothing is pooled across them.

units.definition: one training seed; the three arms share initialization and every minibatch and are matched repeated measures
units.population_note: Inference covers training randomness on one fixed data sample (data_seed 20261004), the under_normalized host and the conv_heavy seed, at a 10-epoch horizon with germination before epoch 2.

endpoint.metric: development cross-entropy (nats) over all 5,000 dev examples
endpoint.per_unit_reduction: mean dev CE over the late epochs per finished arm; one paired difference per unit per contrast, over units where both of its arms finished

analysis.test: paired t intervals at 98.75% (Bonferroni over two co-primaries within a family_alpha of 0.025; the rung's four co-primaries across both sibling plans share 0.05), percentile bootstrap check
analysis.multiplicity: One family of four co-primaries across the two sibling plans (alpha 0.0125 each), because rung 3 is answered by both seed types together and the cells share host trajectories.
analysis.exclusions: diverged_arm_policy per_contrast: a unit enters each contrast iff both of its arms finished. Divergences are counted per arm with exact bounds and gate the reading (max_graft_failures, max_static_failures); they never silently drop a unit. A unit that fails verification is recorded with its traceback. No unit is re-run.
analysis.sensitivity: Each co-primary pair lost to a divergence is imputed at the observed difference favouring one arm, independently per co-primary (every corner: 4 when both co-primaries lose pairs), and the reading is recomputed; the report states whether it moves. A declared heuristic, not a bound: a diverged arm may lie outside the observed range (validation: diverging seeds carried larger deficits). The headline stays on finished pairs.
analysis.capture_fraction: Reported descriptively: mean(graft - no growth) / mean(static - no growth) over units with all three arms finished, with a 95% paired bootstrap interval. The interval is withheld (with a note) if the resampled denominator reaches >= 0 in any resample. No verdict.
analysis.deficit_note: static_minus_no_growth is descriptive here. For norm it re-measures rung 2's deficit; for conv_heavy it is that seed type's first deficit measurement (rung 2 was met with norm only). If static does not beat no growth, there is no deficit to capture; the rule does not consult this contrast, but the two co-primaries imply it, and the capture fraction is then withheld.
analysis.interim_looks: None. Analysis refuses an unfinished fleet. Both sibling fleets are launched before either is analysed.
analysis.selection_diagnostic: Units whose static arm diverged still have graft and no-growth results; graft - no growth is reported separately for static-finished and static-diverged units, the only direct evidence on whether static losses are selective.
analysis.per_arm_summaries: Per-arm late CE, epoch trajectories and costs are averaged over the units where that arm finished (arm_finite_n), never mixing truncated diverged attempts with finished arms.

decision.delta_rationale: Retained from the pre-existing graft floor (PDR-0044, PDR-0046), which predates every lifecycle-v2 estimate. PDR-0049 said the next floor would be set in the graft redesign; PDR-0052 records this retention and its reason. delta gates precision and progress only; partial_capture has no value floor by design (PDR-0046 F1). The live quantity is the capture-fraction interval.
decision.caps_rationale: max_graft_failures 3 of 96: lifecycle v2 diverged 0/48 in validation (exact one-sided 95% bound 6.05%); at a true 1% rate the cap reads graft_unstable with probability 0.017, at 3% 0.33, at 6% 0.84. max_static_failures 10 of 96: the static norm arm diverged 2/72 on this host (95% interval 0.3%-9.7%, simic-9c5c3a2acf); 10 is about the upper end. Beyond it the static comparison is not credible.

readings.graft_unstable: More than 3 of 96 graft arms diverged under lifecycle v2: v2 is not stable at this scale. Diagnose from the recorded stage and witness before any capture claim.
readings.reopen_instrument_imprecise: The no-growth contrast does not resolve (half-width > delta): report the MDE; redesign.
readings.partial_capture: Static beats the graft AND the graft beats no growth: lifecycle v2 repairs part of the deficit. Report the capture fraction. Rung 4 (timing and location) asks whether earlier or different grafting captures more.
readings.reopen_static_wins: Static beats the graft and the graft does not beat no growth: the graft captures none of the repair at this horizon. Check the trajectories: part of a static advantage may be a head start. Composed with the sibling, no capture on both stops the ladder at rung 3 (PDR-0050).
readings.reopen_static_not_credible: Static failures exceed the cap, or the static contrast does not resolve while static does not win: report; the graft-vs-static question needs a stable comparator or more units.
readings.progress: The graft beats no growth beyond delta and static does not beat it: the lifecycle captures (nearly) all of the repair. Shape rung 4.
readings.reopen_no_value: Precise, but the graft neither beats no growth beyond delta nor reaches partial capture.
readings.instrument_failure: More than 2 units failed verification, fewer than 3 analysable, or a co-primary contrast has fewer than 3 pairs: investigate before any re-run; any re-run uses fresh seeds.

decision.cost_note: The conv_heavy seed's parameter count is identical in both arms that carry it; optimizer parameter-steps and wall time are reported from the run summaries.
decision.rung_composition: Rung-3 verdict composed from the two sibling plans (PDR-0052 table). The first matching row applies. Conclusive readings: progress, partial_capture, reopen_static_wins, reopen_no_value. Inconclusive: reopen_static_not_credible, reopen_instrument_imprecise. 1. graft_unstable in either -> lifecycle v2 unstable at scale, no capture claim, diagnose before rung 4. 2. instrument_failure in either -> that seed type unresolved, re-run on fresh seeds, no rung verdict until resolved. 3. progress + progress -> capture. 4. both in {progress, partial_capture}, not both progress -> partial capture (static wins at the declared cost, ADR-0018). 5. both in {reopen_static_wins, reopen_no_value} -> no capture; the ladder stops at rung 3 (PDR-0050). 6. one in {progress, partial_capture}, the other in {reopen_static_wins, reopen_no_value} -> seed-type dependent; rung 3 met only for the capturing seed type. 7. one conclusive, the other inconclusive -> the verdict from the conclusive plan alone, labelled single-seed-type; a single-seed-type no capture does NOT stop the ladder: it holds pending the inconclusive plan's own consequence (a new PDR). 8. both inconclusive -> rung 3 unresolved, no verdict; each plan routes to its own consequence.

reading_probabilities.method: 2,000 simulated 96-unit studies per row through the committed contrast_entries and reading_graft_capture_v2 (bivariate normal paired differences, Bernoulli graft and static divergences, caps 3 and 10). Static gain over no growth is the validation estimate; capture is varied.

predictions.expected_reading: partial_capture (probability >= 0.97 at the observed capture of about 0.382, at both the point and the upper-confidence sd).

disclosures: The lifecycle-v2-validation cell B estimates were seen before this plan was written; partial_capture is the predictable reading. The effect is not used for sizing; the sd (and its 95% upper confidence limit) is.
n = 96 is set so the graft - static half-width at the sd's upper confidence limit is <= delta in cell A (0.043 at alpha 0.0125); the same n is used for both seed types.
The reading rule graft-capture-v2 is graft-capture-v1's precedence behind two divergence gates; graft-capture-v1 is unchanged in the code as its frozen record.
This plan and its sibling share one host trajectory per seed: their no-growth arms are bitwise identical by construction.

Execution profile: GPU, Academy-exact per SKU (2x RTX 4060 Ti); one process per GPU; GPU lineage only. Units train and are analysed from one immutable snapshot of the launch commit; data identity is pinned.
Analysis must run promptly on this host with a GPU visible (verify_run compares each manifest's runtime with the analysing process).
deviations: From graft-capture-v1: lifecycle v2 (trust-curvature clamp, PDR-0051); GPU execution profile; 96 fresh seeds (7001-7096) instead of 48; a sibling plan for conv_heavy; diverged_arm_policy per_contrast instead of fail_unit; reading rule graft-capture-v2 (adds graft_unstable and a static-failure gate); family_alpha 0.025 per plan; pinned data identity; imputation sensitivity and capture-fraction interval added; max_failed_units 2 (verification failures only, divergences are counted separately).

Pre-launch review amendments (statistics, product and code reviews of e63a1e3): every-corner imputation sensitivity; static-loss selection diagnostic; capture-interval guard; v1 gates published under every reading; per-arm summaries over finished arms; fit/dev data pin checked at launch; malformed pins, unfireable caps and older rules under per_contrast refused at load; rung-3 composition pinned in decision.rung_composition.
